questions.question: A therapist applies a hot pack to the lumbar region of a patient rehabilitating from a lumbar laminectomy. Which mode of heat transmission is utilized with hot packs?
questions.explanation: Hot packs transfer heat by conduction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The earth pin of the plug socket is larger as:

options.A: It allows one-way entry of the socket
options.B: It allows the earth pin to enter first and come out last

questions.explanation: The earth pin is longer so it connects first and breaks last, and it also prevents wrong insertion.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The fuse in a power circuit should break:
questions.explanation: A fuse should break both live and neutral wires.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The switches in the apparatus should break:
questions.explanation: Switches on apparatus should break both live and neutral wires.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The earth pin should be connected to:

options.A: The wire with black or blue color
options.B: The wire with yellow or green color
options.C: The wire with red or brown color

questions.explanation: The earth wire is yellow/green.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Rectification of a circuit is achieved using:
questions.explanation: Rectification uses a diode valve.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The device used to regulate current is:
questions.explanation: A rheostat regulates current by altering resistance.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The amount of heat produced during treatment with an electric current increases if:

options.B: The treatment time is of a short interval
options.C: The total current is not high

questions.explanation: Heat rises when skin impedance is high because heat is proportional to I squared R.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following is a true sentence:

options.A: After a severe shock there is paralysis of the respiratory muscles
options.B: Hot drinks should be avoided following a shock
options.C: After a severe shock there is rise in blood pressure
options.D: Shocks are more severe with direct currents

questions.explanation: Hot drinks should be avoided after a shock.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The device used to regulate current by altering the resistance or the potential of the circuit is:
questions.explanation: A rheostat regulates current by altering resistance or potential.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Thermionic valve is a device that allows electrons to flow in:
questions.explanation: A thermionic valve permits electron flow in one direction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The device that measures electrical resistance is:
questions.explanation: An ohmmeter measures resistance.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: EMF of any cell can be measured by: Electrotherapy 37
questions.explanation: A potentiometer can measure the EMF of a cell.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The instrument used to measure current intensity is:
questions.explanation: An ammeter measures current intensity.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Lenz's law deals with:

options.B: Rate of change of magnetic field

questions.explanation: Lenz's law gives the direction of the induced EMF.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Joule's law expresses the relation between:
questions.explanation: Joule's law relates heat to current, resistance and time.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: High inductance can be incorporated into a conducting coil by:

options.C: Winding the coil into a soft iron core

questions.explanation: Inductance rises with more turns, closer turns and a soft iron core.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Average pH of water in the therapeutic pool:
questions.explanation: Therapeutic pool water is kept at about neutral pH (about 7.5 to 7.8).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 180

questions.question: When two opposite phases are contained in a single pulse, the wave form is termed as:
questions.explanation: A pulse with two opposite phases is biphasic.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Rehabilitation O'Sullivan/4th Ed./Pg. 233

questions.question: The resting membrane potential of the skeletal muscle cell is:
questions.explanation: The resting potential of skeletal muscle is about minus 90 mV.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 227

questions.question: The resting nerve is positive outside due to concentration of:
questions.explanation: The outside of a resting nerve is positive because of sodium (and chloride) ions.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 227

questions.question: A current that produces greater muscular hypertrophy with gain in strength is:
questions.explanation: Russian current produces the greatest strength and hypertrophy gains.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The low frequency currents have a frequency of:
questions.explanation: Low-frequency currents are 1 to 1000 Hz.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The original faradic current was:
questions.explanation: The original faradic current was an unevenly alternating induced current.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: When direct current is passed through the cathode, it increases the excitability of the nerve. This is termed as:
questions.explanation: Increased excitability under the cathode is catelectrotonus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 29

questions.question: The state of decreased excitability of a nerve near the anode is termed as:
questions.explanation: Decreased excitability of a nerve near the anode is anelectrotonus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The smallest current that produces a muscle contraction when the stimulus is of infinite duration is:
questions.explanation: Rheobase is the smallest current that produces a contraction at infinite pulse duration.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The shape of the curve in strength duration curve indicates:
questions.explanation: The shape of the strength-duration curve indicates the proportion of denervation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The resting nerve is:
questions.explanation: A resting nerve is negative inside and positive outside.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 227

questions.question: When a healthy innervated muscle is stimulated with an electrical current, we stimulate the:
questions.explanation: With an innervated muscle the current stimulates the motor nerve (axon membrane).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 61

questions.question: The resting membrane potential of a nerve cell is:
questions.explanation: The resting membrane potential of nerve is about minus 70 mV.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 60

questions.question: Selective impulses are used for stimulation of:
questions.explanation: Selective (exponential/triangular) impulses are used to stimulate denervated muscle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 83

questions.question: Conventional TENS is:
questions.explanation: Conventional TENS is high frequency and low intensity.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The constant current stimulator is:
questions.explanation: A constant-current stimulator delivers current more accurately despite changes in skin resistance.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the statement is a false?

options.A: Edema due to disruption of blood vessels is alleviated with HVPC
options.B: Polarity is the predominant current characteristic to be considered in wound healing
options.C: HVPC can be used for muscle re-education
options.D: HVPC has a single monophasic wave form

questions.explanation: HVPC is a twin-peak monophasic pulse, not a single monophasic waveform.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Electrotherapy Explained/Low and Reed/3rd Ed./Pg. 62

questions.question: To stretch adherent scar, the ion selected for iontophoresis is:
questions.explanation: Chloride delivered at the cathode is used to soften adherent scar.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the ions delivered through iontophoresis can be used in the treatment of calcific deposits?
questions.explanation: Acetate is used to treat calcific deposits.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding diadynamic current is false?

options.A: It is sine wave at a frequency of 100 Hz
options.B: It is either full wave or half wave rectified
options.C: It is a biphasic pulsed current
options.D: It is a unidirectional current flow with long pulse duration

questions.explanation: Diadynamic currents are unidirectional (monophasic) rectified currents, not biphasic.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The term Russian current applies to stimulators:

options.A: Which produces an asymmetric monophasic pulse from
options.B: Which have a ramp-up and ramp down mode
options.C: Which modulate a continuous sine wave
options.D: Which produces sine waves with full wave rectifaction

questions.explanation: Russian stimulation modulates a continuous 2500 Hz sine wave into bursts.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding effects of direct current is false?

options.A: It causes excitation of peripheral nerves
options.B: It cause alteration in protein synthesis
options.D: It causes change in thermal and chemical balance of tissues

questions.explanation: Direct current does not cause smooth muscle contraction in the manner described; it affects excitability, chemistry and temperature.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Electrotherapy Explained/Low and Reed/3rd Ed./Pg. 41

questions.question: In monopolar technique the dispersive electrode:
questions.explanation: The large dispersive electrode minimises current density.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A complete interference pattern is a feature of:
questions.explanation: A complete interference pattern is seen in normal muscle on maximal voluntary contraction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The reaction seen under the cathode when a direct current is passed through it is:
questions.explanation: The cathode produces an alkaline reaction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding interferential current therapy is true?

options.A: Bipolar method does not provide endogenous interferential current
options.B: In quadripolar technique the current at the electrode skin interference is modulated
options.C: In quadripolar approach the stimulus is stronger on the skin
options.D: Bipolar method is difficult and time consuming

questions.explanation: In the quadripolar technique the current at the electrode-skin interface is modulated.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In cases of diffuse area of pathology, the IFT mode selected is:
questions.explanation: Scanning mode is used for diffuse areas of pathology.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In order to produce muscle contraction the frequency of interferential current selected is:
questions.explanation: A beat frequency of about 1-100 Hz produces muscle contraction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The modality of choice for the treatment of postnatal perineal pain would be:
questions.explanation: Pulsed electromagnetic energy is used for postnatal perineal pain.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The unknown resistance of a circuit can be known by:
questions.explanation: An unknown resistance can be measured with a Wheatstone bridge.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Thermal conductivity of which of the following is least?
questions.explanation: Fat has the lowest thermal conductivity of the listed tissues.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 35

questions.question: TENS is a:
questions.explanation: TENS is a low-frequency current.

questions.question: The dielectric constant of tissues with high water content: 40

options.A: is less than the fatty tissue
options.C: is less than the bony tissue
options.D: is more than the tissue with low water content

questions.explanation: Tissues with high water content have a higher dielectric constant.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The dielectric constant of water is:
questions.explanation: The dielectric constant of water is about 81.

questions.question: A capacitor is a device for:
questions.explanation: A capacitor stores electrical charge.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Contraindications for hydrotherapy pool treatment is:
questions.explanation: Bowel incontinence, seizures and open wounds are all contraindications to pool treatment.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following situations would be contraindicated when using transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation?

options.D: Use to diminish phantom limb sensation.

questions.explanation: TENS over a pregnant uterus is contraindicated.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A physical therapist treats a patient using transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation. Which condition would not be considered a contraindication for TENS?

options.C: Use on a patient with a cardiac pacemaker
options.D: Use during labor and delivery Heating Modalities

questions.explanation: TENS during labour is acceptable (low back), while carotid sinus, pacemaker and pregnant uterus are contraindications.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Energy required to change the state of a substance is:
questions.explanation: Energy to change state is latent heat.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The property of a device that enables it to store electrical energy by means of an electromagnetic field:

questions.question: Transmission of heat due to convection primarily takes place in:
questions.explanation: Convection occurs in fluids.

questions.question: The law that tells about the direct relationship of the metabolic rate to increase in tissue temperature is:

questions.question: Skin resistance can be decreased by:

questions.question: A magnaplode stands for:

questions.question: For thermal effect to be produced by PSWD, the mean power exceeds:

questions.question: Strong superficial heating relieves pain by:
questions.explanation: Strong superficial heating relieves pain mainly by counter-irritation.

questions.question: The term decimeter wave applies:
questions.explanation: The term decimetre wave applies to microwave diathermy.

questions.question: The term diathermy means:
questions.explanation: Diathermy means through-and-through heating.

questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 388

questions.question: The cable method in SWD is called:

questions.question: The commonly used therapeutic frequency of SWD is:

questions.question: Whenever deeply placed structures are to be treated with the capacitor field method, which of the following technique would be used?

questions.question: The electrode spacing material used in SWD should be:

questions.question: For a given treatment area what should be the appropriate size of the SWD electrodes?

options.A: Smaller than of the part to be treated
options.B: Little larger than the part to be treated
options.C: One electrode larger than the other
options.D: Equal to the area to be treated

questions.explanation: Electrodes should be slightly larger than the treated part.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The amount of heat delivered to the body by moist hot pack is more than PWB, because:

options.A: The specific heat of water is more than wax
options.B: The specific heat of wax is more than convection
options.C: Moist heat produces heat in body by convection

questions.explanation: Moist packs deliver more heat because the specific heat of water exceeds that of wax.

questions.question: The number of layers of towel between the moist pack and skin should have at least:

questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The proportion of solid wax to mineral oil in Paraffin wax treatments should be:

questions.question: Which one of the following regarding dry and moist heat treatment is true?

options.A: Dry heat causes strong superficial heating whereas moist heat causes deep heating
options.B: Moist heat causes strong superficial heating whereas dry heat causes deep heating

questions.explanation: Dry heat gives strong superficial heating, whereas moist heat penetrates somewhat deeper.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./ Pg. 168/174

questions.question: The temperature of fluidotherapy unit should be:
questions.explanation: Fluidotherapy units run at about 38 to 45 degrees Celsius.

questions.question: Therapeutically eddy current is used to:
questions.explanation: Eddy currents are used therapeutically to produce heat.

questions.question: Fluidotherapy refers to:
questions.explanation: Fluidotherapy is a dry heat modality.

questions.question: The contraplanar, capacitor field method of shortwave diathermy is used for treatment of:

questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: When different sized electrodes are used for application of SWD by coplanar method:

options.A: The heating effect will not be there
options.B: Very deep effect will be achieved
options.C: Concentration of heat will be achieved
options.D: Superficial heating under the small electrodes will occur

questions.explanation: With unequal electrodes heat is concentrated under the smaller electrode.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In contrast bath he period of immersion in hot and cold bath is as:

options.A: Hot water - 30 seconds, cold water - 10 seconds
options.B: Hot water - 10 seconds, cold water - 30 seconds
options.C: Hot water - 3 - 4 minutes, cold water - 1 minute
options.D: Hot water - 1 minutes, cold water - 3 - 4 minutes

questions.explanation: Contrast bath: hot 3-4 minutes, cold 1 minute.

questions.question: The choice of modality to treat painful joints of hand of a rheumatoid arthritic patient is:

questions.question: The thermal conductivity in which of the following tissues is higher?

questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 135

questions.question: Heliotherapy is treatment by:
questions.explanation: Heliotherapy is treatment with natural sunlight.

questions.question: A 55-year-old female diagnosed with a right hip intertrochanteric fracture is eight weeks status postopen reduction and internal fixation with a plate and pinning. questions.question: A therapist examines a morbidly obese patient in physical therapy. questions.question: All of the following are used frequently by a physical therapist to treat temporomandibular joint disorders except:

questions.question: An example of a heating agent which can cause temperature elevation in tissues to depths of three centimeters or more includes:

questions.question: Shortwave diathermy is used for all of the following except:

questions.question: To reduce spasticity following modality is more suitable:
questions.explanation: Cryotherapy temporarily reduces spasticity.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 180

questions.question: A physical therapist immerses a patient's edematous ankle in cold water. When a body part comes in direct contact with a cold agent the energy is transferred through:
questions.explanation: Direct contact with a cold agent transfers heat by conduction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which objective would not be accomplished using cold packs on an involved lower extremity?
questions.explanation: Cold causes vasoconstriction, not vasodilatation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 135

questions.question: A therapist tests a small area of skin for hypersensitivity prior to using a cold immersion bath. The patient begins to demonstrate evidence of cold intolerance within 60 seconds after cold application. The most appropriate response is to:

options.A: Limit cold exposure to ten minutes or less
options.C: Continue with the cold immersion bath
options.D: Discontinue cold application and document you findings Traction

questions.explanation: Stop cold application and document if cold intolerance appears.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 144

questions.question: In cervical spine, posterior vertebral separation occurs at a flexion angel of:
questions.explanation: Posterior vertebral separation is greatest at about 20-30 degrees of neck flexion.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In prone lying the lumbar spine is:
questions.explanation: In prone lying the lumbar spine is partly extended.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 310

questions.question: Which of the following is a contraindication for cervical traction?
questions.explanation: Rheumatoid arthritis (atlantoaxial instability) contraindicates cervical traction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 305

questions.question: Continuous traction is applied with:

options.A: Small weights for long periods of time
options.B: Small weights for short periods of time
options.C: Heavier weights for long periods of time
options.D: Heavier weights for short periods of time

questions.explanation: Continuous traction uses small weights for long periods.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 318-319

questions.question: A physical therapist receives a referral for lumbar traction on a 61 year old female diagnosed with chronic lumbar pain. During the history the patient states that she sustained a compression fracture at the L4 level six weeks ago. The most appropriate action is:

options.A: Initiate lumbar traction in a prone position only
options.B: Initiate lumbar traction since the compression fracture was six weeks age
options.C: Contact the physician and discuss your concerns
options.D: Inform the physician that the referral showed poor judgment

questions.explanation: A recent vertebral compression fracture requires consultation with the physician before lumbar traction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The tractive force applied for the lumber spine in PIVD is:
questions.explanation: About 25% of body weight is used initially for lumbar traction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/Cameron/2nd Ed./Pg. 324

questions.question: The law that gives reciprocal relationship between the distance and intensity from the source to surface is:
questions.explanation: Intensity falls with the square of the distance from the source.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The reflector that makes the rays to emerge parallel from its surface, thereby having uniform irradiations a:
questions.explanation: A parabolic reflector produces a parallel beam.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The ability of a conductor to have electric current induced is known as:
questions.explanation: The ability of a conductor to have current induced is inductance.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The capacitance of a condenser is:

options.A: The ratio of the charge to its potential
options.B: Product of its charge to potential
options.C: Ratio of its potential to the charge

questions.explanation: Capacitance is the ratio of charge to potential.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Dielectric constant of dry air is:
questions.explanation: The dielectric constant of dry air is 1.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: In a condenser the spacing material should have:
questions.explanation: A low-dielectric spacing material is chosen in SWD electrodes.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Statement is true:

options.A: Rheobase is the duration of impulse that produces a muscle contraction
options.B: In an UMN lesion there is an altered response to electrical stimulation
options.C: A current which rises or falls suddenly is more effective in stimulating an innervated muscle
options.D: Strength--duration curve indicates the site of lesion

questions.explanation: A sudden-rise current stimulates innervated muscle more effectively than a slow-rise one because of accommodation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Insertional activity is found in:
questions.explanation: Insertional activity is present in innervated muscle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Rehabilitation O'Sullivan/4th Ed./Pg. 222

questions.question: An EMG potential is called polyphasic if:

options.C: It has more than four phases

questions.explanation: A polyphasic potential has more than four phases.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Rehabilitation O'Sullivan/4th Ed./Pg. 223

questions.question: The normal values of motor NCV in the upper limb are:
questions.explanation: Upper limb motor conduction velocity is about 45-70 m/s.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following EMG picture is true in the diagnosis of myopathy?

options.A: Spontaneous activity and partial interference pattern of decreased amplitude and duration on volition
options.B: Spontaneous activity with short duration low amplitude polyphasic potential on volition
options.C: High frequency respective discharge with alternate increased and decreased in amplitude

questions.explanation: Myopathy shows short-duration, low-amplitude polyphasic potentials.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Rehabilitation O'Sullivan/4th Ed./Pg. 223

questions.question: The optimal pH level of water in therapeutic pool is maintained at:
questions.explanation: Pool water pH is kept at about 7.5.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
